summary_md: **拓跋鼠 ([@qwerty__cs](https://x.com/qwerty__cs/status/2116064279581659421))** points to **SenseNova 6.8 Code2Video**, where a 27B model writes code that is then rendered into video, so element positions, layout and timing stay editable; weights, production skills and full execution traces are released under Apache 2.0 ([OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-6.8-Code2Video](https://github.com/OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-6.8-Code2Video)).
